rank_math_title: 5 Day Southern Skeleton Coast Tour from Windhoek
rank_math_desc: 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour: Swakopmund, Walvis Bay cruise, Sandwich Harbour 4x4, Cape Cross seals and Spitzkoppe. From USD 4,200 per adult.
post_content: This 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour is based in Swakopmund for the Living Desert Tour, a Walvis Bay cruise and Sandwich Harbour, then visits Cape Cross and Spitzkoppe.
overview:
This 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour is a guided trip from Windhoek based in Swakopmund, with a final night at Spitzkoppe. It covers the Living Desert Tour and Welwitschia Drive in Dorob National Park, a Walvis Bay catamaran cruise, 4x4 dune driving at Sandwich Harbour and the Cape Cross seal colony. It runs all year, costs from USD 4,200 per adult and suits active travellers who want coast, desert and marine life.

The tour travels in an air-conditioned vehicle with a professional English-speaking guide, and breakfast, park entrance fees, the listed activities and airport transfers are included.

Why choose a 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour?

The 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour is built around the place where the Namib dunes meet the Atlantic. Most Namibia itineraries give the coast a single night; this one gives it three full days, so you can do the Living Desert Tour, the Walvis Bay cruise and Sandwich Harbour without rushing.

The trip also reaches beyond Swakopmund: north to the Cape Cross seal colony, where up to 200,000 Cape fur seals gather, and inland to the granite peaks of Spitzkoppe, the "Matterhorn of Africa", for San rock paintings and a sunrise hike.

  • Wildlife lovers: dolphins, seals and possible whales on the cruise, and desert-adapted creatures in the dunes.
  • Adventure seekers: heavy 4x4 dune driving at Sandwich Harbour and a guided hike on Groot Spitzkoppe.
  • Photographers: pink lakes, shipwrecks on the coast road and Spitzkoppe at first light.

What to expect on the 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour

Day 1 starts with a pick-up from the airport or your Windhoek accommodation and the drive west to the coast for a city tour of Swakopmund's history since the late 1800s, with an optional township tour of Mondesa and DRC. Day 2 is the Living Desert Tour by 4x4 in the dunes of Dorob National Park, then the Welwitschia Drive past lichen fields, the moon landscape and Welwitschia plants over 2,000 years old.

Day 3 begins at the Walvis Bay Waterfront with a catamaran cruise for bottlenose and Benguela dolphins, Cape fur seals, pelicans and seasonal whales, followed after lunch by 4x4 dune driving at Sandwich Harbour, a Ramsar wetland with pink lakes.

Day 4 heads north past a shipwreck to the Cape Cross Seal Reserve, then inland to the Spitzkoppe mountains for San rock paintings. Day 5 starts with an early guided hike on Groot Spitzkoppe before the drive back to Windhoek.

Is the Groot Spitzkoppe hike difficult?

The Groot Spitzkoppe hike is the most demanding part of the tour. The peak rises to 1,728 m and the page describes the route as technical, so an experienced local guide leads the way and the summit is only for fit, confident scramblers. Everyone else can enjoy shorter walks around the base. Our Namibia hiking safari guide and stargazing in Namibia guide cover the area.

What is included in this Swakopmund and Spitzkoppe tour?

The price includes accommodation as per the itinerary, an air-conditioned vehicle, a professional English-speaking guide, breakfast, all listed activities, park entrance fees, water on board, passenger liability insurance and airport transfers.

Not included are flights, visas, health insurance, personal items, and tips and gratuities. Only breakfast is listed, so plan for lunches and dinners in Swakopmund. Our best time to visit Namibia guide helps you choose dates, and our 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour adds the Namib dunes instead.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour?
faq.a: The 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour runs all year, and the trip page does not set a season. The coast stays mild with morning fog, so bring a warm layer for the Walvis Bay cruise. Humpback and southern right whales are most likely from about July to November, and May to September is cooler for the Spitzkoppe hike.

faq.q: What is included in the 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour?
faq.a: The 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour includes accommodation as per the itinerary, an air-conditioned vehicle, a professional English-speaking guide, breakfast, all listed activities, park entrance fees, water on board, passenger liability insurance and airport transfers. Flights, visas, health insurance, personal items and tips are extra, and lunches and dinners are not listed.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour?
faq.a: On the 5 day Southern Skeleton Coast tour you stay three nights around Swakopmund, the base for the desert, Walvis Bay and Sandwich Harbour trips, and one night at Spitzkoppe. The trip page does not name the properties, so we confirm each one in your written quote before you book.

faq.q: Is the Southern Skeleton Coast tour suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes, families can join the Southern Skeleton Coast tour. Children usually love the seals and dolphins on the catamaran, the Living Desert Tour and the Cape Cross colony. The Sandwich Harbour dune drive is bumpy and the Groot Spitzkoppe summit is a technical climb, so tell us your children's ages and we will adjust the plan.
